items.prompt: A sensitivity list tells the simulator…
choices: Which signal events re-run the always block
items.explain: Listed events wake the block; unlisted reads may not trigger updates.

items.prompt: always @(A) Y = A & B; when only B changes…
choices: The block often does not run — Y can stay stale
items.explain: B is read but not in the list, so B-only changes may not wake the block.

items.prompt: always @(posedge clk) Q <= D; when D changes alone…
choices: Q updates on the next rising clock edge
Q updates immediately on every D change
items.explain: Edge-triggered blocks sample inputs only when the clock edge fires.

items.prompt: @(*) is meant to include every signal read in the combinational block.
items.explain: At-star builds a complete implicit sensitivity list for combo logic.
